title: GPT reflection (ref)
desc: GPT family-identity-scoping rule, elder-review duty, and dated incidents.
steps: FAMILY-IDENTITY-SCOPING: keep gpt-reflection and gpt-mini-reflection SEPARATE; never use gpt-mini reflection (or Haiku reflection) as a substitute for GPT reflection. Treating model identity as interchangeable makes future agents inherit the WRONG reflex and the same hook/delegation failure repeats -- a mismatched reflection prompt is an identity-scoping BUG, stop and create the model-specific reflection.

ELDER REVIEW DUTY: GPT reviews mistakes made by smaller sibling models, extracts the DURABLE failure pattern (the missing guard / missing reflection / missing skill-read / bad delegation contract that ALLOWED it), and turns it into recurrence prevention -- do not merely blame the smaller model.
INCIDENT 2026-06-14: GPT delegation + Codex hook repair were delayed by identity confusion between mini/GPT/Haiku reflection requirements; fix = verify the active family before satisfying on-load.

INCIDENT 2026-06-17: do NOT add a user-set environment-variable identity backdoor to agent-name; agent-name must infer identity from PROCESS LINEAGE + session evidence ONLY, never from WKHARNESS_AGENT_MODEL or any spoofable env var (keep the resolver read-only w.r.t. user-supplied identity hints).

[2026-07-20 GPT/Codex harness incident cluster] Codex Stop-hook and delegation repair exposed recurring GPT-family risks: no-artifact delegations need explicit sentinel evidence; WKHARNESS_CODEX_HOOK must remain transport-only and never set model/tier; Codex built-in spawn_agent/wait_agent must normalize to Claude-format delegation with caller-model inheritance; busy-fleet/stall must allow dispatch and result harvesting; cheap-model canary must use explicit cheap model rather than inherited pro/root. Proof artifacts live under tools/wkharness-codex-*probe*.ps1 with self-tests; canonical promotion belongs in common delegation classifier wiring.

INCIDENT CLUSTER 2026-07-21 Codex harness repair: GPT root hit repeated model-scope, busy-fleet, stall, and debrief deadlocks while stabilizing Codex hook integration. Durable lessons: keep WKHARNESS_CODEX_HOOK transport-only, verify real model identity before reflection/delegation, require cheap workers to produce exact PASS/FAIL structural proof, count Codex wait_agent function_call_output as delegation completion, avoid regex replacements with dollar variables in hook files, and restore broken hook files before preserving feature work. Proof artifacts include tools/wkharness-codex-busyfleet-completion-probe-test.ps1 and tools/wkharness-common-skillscore-codex.ps1.

INCIDENT CLUSTER 2026-07-22 Codex native delegation and debrief repair: gpt-reflection had grown to 29 steps and decayed to 59/100, blocking Agent.cmd proactive freshness. Root fixed one live Codex bug in commit 3844d9bb0 by mapping bare spawn_agent to Agent and allowing it as native delegation. Follow-up live evidence showed wait_agent and close_agent surface as Tool: multi_agent_v1wait_agent / multi_agent_v1close_agent, so the Codex adapter needs dotted and undotted lifecycle aliases. Debrief-gate also misses real AppBot/Codex skill-edit transcript shapes: response_item.payload.arguments JSON and [ACT] cmd=skill args='edit <skill> --add-step ...'. Proof commands: git show --stat --oneline 3844d9bb0; wkappbot skill read gpt-reflection; Agent.cmd blocked with proactive freshness score 59/100.

INCIDENT 2026-07-22 approval prompt trap: Direct Agent.cmd from Codex can trigger a pre-harness Codex approval dialog before wkharness can decide. Do not use Agent.cmd direct calls in Codex repair loops when the user asked to avoid approvals; prefer already-approved wkappbot skill/file/git routes or native spawn_agent after Codex adapter aliases are fixed.

INCIDENT 2026-07-22 worker approval prompt: subagent 019f85d0 attempted to request approval for a long PowerShell one-liner that writes files. Corrective instruction: do not approve or repeat arbitrary command-line coding; use wkappbot file edit, reusable repo wk-*.cmd tooling, or .tmp patch/probe plans for ROOT promotion. This preserves user no-approval preference and avoids quoting-damaged source edits.

INCIDENT 2026-07-22 Codex native write fail-closed patch: user directed that if Codex native edit/write/apply_patch may trigger approval or cannot be classified safely, the Codex harness must block it and tell agents to use wkappbot file edit/write/read. Implemented in tools/wkharness-codex-main.ps1 as [codex-native-write-deny] for apply_patch/edit_file/write_file/create_file, plus undotted multi_agent_v1 lifecycle aliases for wait/close/etc. Verification: PowerShell parser PARSE_OK, git diff --check exit 0, readback lines 516-534.

DECISION 2026-07-22 Codex delegation simplification: do not keep growing hardcoded support for every Codex native delegation tool variant. Prefer a Codex adapter normalization function for unavoidable native tool names, and guide routine delegation toward the canonical Agent.cmd/AppBot route once its Codex approval friction is cleaned up. Family-stable principle: one normalization point per family, shared guards consume Claude-shaped canonical names.

[FIXED][2026-07-23][codex-study-lock-read-wrapper-gap] If study-lock-v2 says a source file was not read after Codex used tools/Read.cmd or wkappbot file read, check Test-WkSourceReadThisSession in tools/wkharness-common-skilllock.ps1. Fixed by recognizing shell lines containing Read.cmd and wkappbot file read, and by reconnecting wk-sourceread-test.cmd to the real helper. Verify with wk-sourceread-test.cmd, parser on wkharness-common-skilllock.ps1, and git diff --check.

[INCIDENT][2026-07-23][parallel-skill-edit-corrupts-json] Do not run concurrent wkappbot skill edit commands against the same skill id. Two simultaneous edits to gpt-reflection-ref produced a duplicated JSON tail and broke skill loading. Recovery was git checkout for that one skill file, then sequential skill edit reapply. Rule: skill edits are root-only and same-skill edits must be strictly sequential.

2026-07-24 Codex live JSONL probe repair: tools\\wkharness-codex-delegation-jsonl-live-shape-probe.ps1 had three probe bugs that hid delegation-shape evidence: a missing closing parenthesis after Select-Object -First, File.ReadLines failing on active Codex session JSONL locked by another process, and StrictMode crashes on optional payload.name/type fields. Fix pattern: close the pipeline array, read live JSONL with FileShare.ReadWrite StreamReader, and check PSObject.Properties before optional field access. Proof: wk-parsecheck.cmd on every tools/*codex*.ps1 returned no failures, the live-shape probe exited PASS files=10 matches=58 parse_failures=0, and current-delegation/busyfleet completion probe tests passed.

2026-07-24 Codex hook contract repair: wk-codex-hook-test.ps1 was stale after CodexPreToolPolicy.ps1 switched to route-all-to-shared-harness. Test expectations must accept route_allow_if_harness_allows for apply_patch and validate Codex hook JSON under hookSpecificOutput, not top-level decision/reason. Also avoid asserting the global ~/.codex/wkharness-user-approval.json final value inside hook tests because ordinary shell PreToolUse calls can update that shared snapshot during the test session; assert the PermissionRequest stdout behavior instead. CodexHookAdapter.ps1 now records deny decisions to the approval snapshot while preserving consumed allow behavior. Proof: wk-parsecheck.cmd tools\\CodexHookAdapter.ps1, wk-parsecheck.cmd tools\\wk-codex-hook-test.ps1, tools\\wk-codex-hook-test.ps1 (26 pass/0 fail), and the full tools/*codex* test/selftest set completed without a failing exit.

2026-07-24 Codex pace emergency handoff: when Codex budget must be conserved until reset, stop broad exploration and finish only emergency integration checks plus knowledge-ification. Root should keep inference/verification, avoid direct codex CLI, and prefer repo probes that do not spend Codex quota. Proof: tools\\wkharness-codex-pace-root-action-probe.ps1 verifies Codex pace-95 calls a block for a normal root Bash action while leaving Agent.cmd delegation open.

2026-07-24 Codex pace probe preservation: important probe files matching gitignore patterns such as *-probe.ps1 must carry an in-source harness:skill block with literal wkappbot skill read command lines, be verified no-BOM, then be committed with git add -f so successor cleanup does not delete the proof. Proof: tools\\wkharness-codex-pace-root-action-probe.ps1 starts with gpt-reflection, codex-cli-wkappbot-usage, and harness-pace-guard skill-read lines and passes the root-action/delegation-open probe.

2026-07-28 INCIDENT: ROOT sent a final answer even though the Stop hook was still failing. Reflex: a Stop-hook failure is not a stopping point; continue the repair loop, sharpen delegation briefs, and only final-answer after Stop behavior is verified or the remaining blocker is explicitly captured.

[INCIDENT][2026-07-23][agentcmd-completion-not-opening-busyfleet-window] Symptom: after a real Agent.cmd --model gpt read-only worker returned evidence, Codex ROOT wkappbot file edit was still blocked by busy-fleet as if no delegation/completion occurred. Root-cause class: Codex busy-fleet/stall delegation credit is still incomplete for Agent.cmd completion output even when the child exits and prints a result. Fix direction: common delegation completion detection must credit Agent.cmd child completion, not only native wait_agent/subagent_notification shapes. Proof: Agent.cmd returned the stale Agent.ps1 help-line evidence, then the immediate wkappbot file edit remained busy-fleet-blocked.

2026-07-23 Codex busy-fleet integration fix: Get-WkActiveSessionJsonl in tools/wkharness-codex-main.ps1 must not rely only on the first session_meta payload.cwd line. Symptom: real Agent.cmd or Codex delegation completed, but busy-fleet/stall could still miss the current session JSONL after cwd/session context moved. Fix: keep CODEX_THREAD_ID filename match first, then scan bounded head+tail JSONL lines for cwd in cwd, payload.cwd, context.cwd, turn_context.cwd, turn_context.payload.cwd, payload.context.cwd, and payload.turn_context.cwd. Proof: wk-parsecheck.cmd tools\\wkharness-codex-main.ps1, tools\\wkharness-codex-current-delegation-jsonl-shape-probe-test.ps1, tools\\wkharness-codex-busyfleet-completion-probe-test.ps1, wk-codex-post-test.cmd, and wk-test.cmd all exited 0.

2026-06-30 EXECUTION FAILURES. GPT (1) reported gg failures and stopped instead of diagnosing, retrying, and completing safe follow-up work; (2) read a local SKILL.md directly although this repository requires AppBot skill commands; (3) launched chrome.exe with an invented D:/tmp user-data-dir after cdp open failed, hiding the established Naver and JobKorea cookies and forcing needless authentication; (4) used global CDP paths after the user required the repository wk-cdp.cmd tool; and (5) repeatedly treated status reporting as task completion. Root cause class: instruction knowledge was loaded but not converted into executable constraints, and recovery improvisation outranked repository invariants. Fix: load skills only through wkappbot skill read; use repository launchers first; never invent profile paths; on failure follow stabilize, root-cause, retry, verify, persist, commit; stop only at a genuine human gate or authority boundary. Proof: show the exact repository command, preserved profile, successful result, saved artifact, and verification output before declaring completion.

2026-06-17 incident: do not add user-set environment-variable identity backdoors to agent-name. Fix: agent-name must infer identity from process lineage and session evidence only, never from WKHARNESS_AGENT_MODEL or any similar spoofable env var. Proof: remove env-first branches from wkagent-name and keep the resolver read-only with respect to user-supplied identity hints.
